asks: Which tools may an extension use?
answer: An extension can use only the tools its manifest names, and installing it grants them. Each tool names what it applies to: a path on a computer, the record of a computer, the requests of a computer, the app. A tool either reads or takes a protective action. In the app, an alert, a question and a panel are protective actions. Which tools Silo offers is settled when they are built.
